integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, vertical 9:16 framing, one continuous top-down close-up over the mouth of a clear glass on a light-wood morning kitchen counter. Hand and spoon only, no face in frame. Clean frame with no subtitles, no captions and no on-screen text.

overall_soundscape: A quiet dawn kitchen room tone. A single clean, granular soft drop as the powder hits the bottom of the glass, like the first beat of a drum, then a light settling hiss of fine dust.
